-- A person "participates" in a post if they joined it OR they host it.
create or replace view public.participants as
  select post_id, user_id from public.joins
  union
  select id as post_id, author_id as user_id from public.posts where author_id is not null;

-- Social graph: who a user has played with, and how many times.
create or replace function public.played_with(p_user uuid)
returns table (
  id uuid, name text, handle text, neighborhood text,
  together bigint, last_at timestamptz, activities text
)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select pr.id, pr.name, pr.handle, pr.neighborhood,
         count(distinct a.post_id) as together,
         max(po.starts_at) as last_at,
         string_agg(distinct po.activity, ', ' order by po.activity) as activities
  from participants a
  join participants b on b.post_id = a.post_id and b.user_id <> a.user_id
  join profiles pr on pr.id = b.user_id
  join posts po on po.id = a.post_id
  where a.user_id = p_user
  group by pr.id, pr.name, pr.handle, pr.neighborhood
  order by together desc, last_at desc nulls last;
$$;

-- Recommendations: upcoming activities ranked for a user, with a reason.
create or replace function public.recommended_posts(p_user uuid)
returns table (
  id text, activity text, location text, starts_at timestamptz,
  duration_min int, price numeric, cap int,
  author_id uuid, author_name text, author_handle text,
  joins_count bigint, reason text
)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  with my_acts as (
    select distinct po.activity
    from participants pa join posts po on po.id = pa.post_id
    where pa.user_id = p_user
  ),
  my_people as (
    select distinct b.user_id as id
    from participants a
    join participants b on b.post_id = a.post_id and b.user_id <> a.user_id
    where a.user_id = p_user
  ),
  jc as (select post_id, count(*) as c from joins group by post_id)
  select po.id, po.activity, po.location, po.starts_at, po.duration_min, po.price, po.cap,
         po.author_id, pr.name as author_name, pr.handle as author_handle,
         coalesce(jc.c, 0) as joins_count,
         case
           when po.author_id in (select id from my_people)
             then 'Hosted by ' || pr.name || ', who you have played with'
           when po.activity in (select activity from my_acts)
             then 'Because you are into ' || lower(po.activity)
           when coalesce(jc.c,0) >= 3 then 'Popular this week'
           else 'New near you'
         end as reason
  from posts po
  join profiles pr on pr.id = po.author_id
  left join jc on jc.post_id = po.id
  where po.status = 'upcoming'
    and po.author_id <> p_user
    and not exists (select 1 from joins j where j.post_id = po.id and j.user_id = p_user)
  order by
    (case when po.author_id in (select id from my_people) then 3 else 0 end)
    + (case when po.activity in (select activity from my_acts) then 2 else 0 end)
    + least(coalesce(jc.c,0), 3) desc,
    po.starts_at asc
  limit 12;
$$;

grant execute on function public.played_with(uuid) to anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function public.recommended_posts(uuid) to anon, authenticated;

**Design:** Direction A "Daylight" (Strava-clean: warm white #FAFAF7, near-black ink, coral #FF4D2E accent, Space Grotesk + Inter). `/styles` route keeps all 3 explored directions (A Daylight, B Sunset/Tinder, C Night/dark) for future switching.
